name: Ground Floor Cafe (Hardback)
description: The Hardback Cafe is located within the Sir Duncan Rice Library and offers a selection of hot and cold snacks, hot drinks and refreshments, using triple-certified Fairtrade, organic and Rainforest Alliance coffee.
sensory_experience: A lively, higher-energy space: noticeably loud with busy footfall, bright and visually active, with food and drink smells around. Comfortable in temperature. Best suited to those who don't mind stimulation.
wayfinding: tip to find anything that might be difficult to find.

name: Ground Floor Study Space
description: The ground floor is the library's main entrance and welcome area. Here you can find the Welcome Desk for enquiries and a café for refreshments, alongside an events area and an exhibition gallery. Practical services include public-information PCs and a returns room for dropping off books. Facilities here are accessible, with accessible toilets, a baby-changing facility, vending machines and a water fountain available to visitors.

name: First Floor Study Space
description: The first floor is a group study floor, where you can find the Information Centre and IT help desk. It offers a range of study spaces — including plug booths, a silent study room, a music resource room, and a multimedia room — alongside self-service kiosks and multifunction printing/photocopying/scanning devices. Specialist collections include the Heavy Demand Collection and a current newspaper area. Practical facilities include a microform room, accessible and standard toilets, a first aid room, and a water fountain.

name: Second Floor Study Space
description: The library's second floor is a group study floor. It offers designated quiet study area, PC connections and monitors, a multimedia room, MFDs (print/photocopy/scan), and accessible toilets.

name: Third Floor Study Space
description: The library's third floor is a group study floor. With a designated quiet study area, Co-Labs collaborative spaces, an information point, reader carrels, silent study rooms, self-service kiosks, print/photocopy/scan devices, accessible toilets and a water fountain.

name: Fourth Floor Study Space
description: The library's fourth floor, a quiet study floor with plug booths, Co-Labs collaborative spaces, an information point, a designated quiet study area, silent study rooms, self-service kiosks, print/photocopy/scan devices, accessible toilets and a water fountain.

name: Fifth Floor Study Space
description: The library's fifth floor, a silent study floor with Co-Labs collaborative spaces, an information point, a quiet study area, a reader carrel, silent study rooms, self-service kiosks, print/photocopy/scan devices, accessible toilets and a water fountain.

name: Sixth Floor Study Space

name: Seventh Floor Study Space
description: The library's seventh and top floor, offering bookable Group Study Rooms 1 & 2 and Meeting Rooms 1 to 3, a flexible learning area, a break-out room with panoramic city views, a quiet study area, self-service kiosks, print/photocopy/scan devices, accessible toilets and a water fountain.

name: Memorial Garden Space
description: An outdoor seating and garden area within the Lady MacRobert Memorial Garden. The space provides benches surrounded by trees, planting and memorial features, offering a place for quiet reflection or rest.
sensory_experience: A generally calm outdoor environment with natural daylight, fresh air and limited sensory stimulation. Noise and crowd levels may vary depending on campus activity and weather conditions.
wayfinding: The garden is located near the central Old Aberdeen campus. Follow the main pedestrian paths to the Lady MacRobert Memorial Garden.

name: Room 233 Common Meeting Area
description: A shared meeting and study area in Room 233 of the Meston Building. The room provides tables, chairs and informal seating for individual work, group discussion and meetings.
opening_hours_note: Access may be restricted outside normal building hours.
sensory_experience: An indoor meeting and study space with artificial lighting, varied seating and moderate visual activity. Noise and movement may increase when the room is used by groups.
wayfinding: Enter the Meston Building and follow the internal signs to Room 233. Confirm the floor and accessible route using the building signage.

name: Room 238 PGR Common Room
description: A postgraduate research common room in Room 238 of the Meston Building. It contains shared tables, chairs and informal seating suitable for individual study, group work and breaks.
opening_hours_note: Access may be limited to authorised postgraduate research students and staff.
sensory_experience: A generally quiet indoor space with artificial lighting and a mixture of study and informal seating. Noise and movement may increase during group discussions or busy periods.
wayfinding: Enter the Meston Building and follow the internal signs to Room 238. Access requirements should be confirmed with the relevant school or department.

name: Common Area 2
description: An informal common area in the Meston Building with tables, chairs and vending facilities. It can be used for short breaks, informal meetings or independent work.
opening_hours_note: Access may be restricted outside normal building hours.
sensory_experience: A moderately active common area with artificial lighting, vending-machine noise and possible food or drink smells. Noise and movement may vary depending on the number of people using the area.
wayfinding: Enter the Meston Building and follow the internal signs towards the common areas. Confirm the exact floor using the building signage.

name: Library Gallery
description: An exhibition gallery within the Sir Duncan Rice Library. The space is used to display exhibitions, collections and other public materials for students, staff and visitors.
opening_hours_note: Gallery access may depend on library opening hours and scheduled exhibitions.
sensory_experience: A visually active exhibition space with display lighting, signage and changing exhibition materials. It is usually calm, although noise and visitor numbers may increase during events or busy periods.
wayfinding: Enter through the main library entrance and follow the signs for the Gallery. The Gallery entrance is accessible from the main public area.

name: Ground Floor Children's Library
description: A designated children's library area on the ground floor of the Sir Duncan Rice Library. It contains children's books, low-level shelving and seating for children and accompanying adults.
opening_hours_note: Access follows the opening hours of the Sir Duncan Rice Library.
sensory_experience: A generally calm library area with natural and artificial lighting, colourful books and low shelving. Noise and movement may increase when children, families or organised groups are present.
wayfinding: Enter through the main library entrance and remain on the ground floor. Follow signs or ask at the Welcome Desk for the children's library area.

name: Union Brew Cafe
description: A cafe within the Students' Union Building offering drinks, refreshments and informal seating. The space can be used for socialising, taking breaks and informal study.
opening_hours_note: Cafe service hours may differ from the opening hours of the Students' Union Building.
sensory_experience: A lively cafe environment with conversation, equipment noise, active footfall, bright lighting and noticeable food and drink smells. It may be highly stimulating during busy periods.
wayfinding: Enter the Students' Union Building and follow the internal signs for Union Brew. Ask at the main reception if assistance is required.

name: Taylor Building Courtyard
description: An outdoor courtyard and pedestrian area beside the Taylor Building. It provides access to surrounding parts of the building and can be used as a calm outdoor space between classes.
opening_hours_note: The outdoor area may remain physically accessible outside building hours; access should be confirmed.
sensory_experience: An outdoor environment with natural daylight, fresh air and generally low sensory stimulation. Noise, movement and crowding may increase between classes or during university events.
wayfinding: Access the courtyard using the external pedestrian paths surrounding the Taylor Building. Confirm step-free access using the available campus route information.

name: Ground Floor Common Area
description: An informal seating area on the ground floor of the William Guild Building, close to the reception and main circulation area. The space contains armchairs and small tables and can be used for short breaks, informal conversations or independent work between classes.
opening_hours_note: Access follows the normal opening hours of the William Guild Building.
sensory_experience: An open indoor common area with bright artificial lighting, natural light from large windows and regular movement from people entering or passing through the building. Noise levels may vary because of its position near reception and the main ground-floor walkway. No strong food or drink smells are expected.
wayfinding: Enter through the main entrance of the William Guild Building. The common area is located on the ground floor near the reception desk and main internal walkway.
